Wizard.Title: Set up Juvin
Wizard.Welcome.Title: Welcome to Juvin
Wizard.Welcome.Body: Juvin rewrites the email you are drafting using the conversation it replies to. These steps connect it to your browser and to a model.
Wizard.Checklist.Title: Setup checklist
Wizard.Checklist.Body: These items let Juvin work on this computer. Required items must be done before you can finish.
Wizard.Done.Title: You are ready
Wizard.Done.Body: Select a draft in your browser and press {0} to rewrite it.
Setup.KeyboardAccess.Title: Keyboard access
Setup.KeyboardAccess.Satisfied: Juvin can read the keyboard, so the shortcut works in every app.
Setup.KeyboardAccess.NeedsAction: Juvin cannot read the keyboard yet, so the shortcut needs another route.
Setup.KeyboardAccess.Detail: Allowing keyboard access adds a system rule (/etc/udev/rules.d/70-juvin-input.rules) that lets the signed-in user read keyboards; Juvin only watches for its shortcut. It asks for your password once. If you prefer not to, choose the desktop shortcut under Shortcuts instead, which needs no password.
Setup.KeyboardAccess.SignOutHint: You are in the input group already, so signing out and back in may be enough.
Setup.KeyboardAccess.Cancelled: The password prompt was closed, so nothing changed.
Setup.KeyboardAccess.Failed: Adding the keyboard rule failed (exit code {0}). Run the command below in a terminal instead.
Setup.KeyboardAccess.NoPkexec: This system has no password prompt for administrator tasks (pkexec). Run the command below in a terminal instead.
Hotkey.Linux.NoKeyboardAccess: Juvin cannot read the keyboard. Allow keyboard access in the setup wizard, or choose the desktop shortcut.
Hotkey.Linux.UnsupportedKey: Juvin cannot listen for that key here. Choose another shortcut.
Hotkey.Linux.NoDesktop: Juvin cannot add shortcuts to this desktop. It supports GNOME, KDE Plasma, Hyprland, and Sway.
Hotkey.Linux.DesktopShortcutFailed: Could not add the shortcut to your desktop settings: {0}
Hotkey.Linux.DesktopShortcutRemoveFailed: Could not remove the shortcut from your desktop settings: {0}
Setup.Accessibility.Title: Accessibility permission
Setup.Accessibility.Granted: Juvin can listen for the rewrite shortcut.
Setup.Accessibility.Missing: Juvin needs Accessibility permission to listen for the rewrite shortcut.
Setup.Accessibility.Detail: Turn on Juvin in System Settings, Privacy and Security, Accessibility. Restart Juvin if the shortcut still does not respond.
Setup.Accessibility.Opened: Turn on Juvin in the list, then check again.
Setup.Accessibility.OpenFailed: System Settings could not be opened. Open Privacy and Security, Accessibility yourself and turn on Juvin.
App.Name: Juvin
Home.Title: Home
Home.Subtitle: What Juvin needs to rewrite your drafts, and whether it is ready.
Home.ConnectorHint: Lets Juvin read the draft and thread you are working on.
Home.ModelHint: The model that writes the rewrite.
Home.ShortcutHint: The key combination that starts a rewrite.
Home.RecentHint: Rewrites appear here when history is turned on in Privacy and data.
Home.SetupHint: Walk through the setup steps again.
Shortcuts.Title: Shortcuts
Shortcuts.Subtitle: The keys that start a rewrite from any app.
Shortcuts.RewriteHint: Captures the selected draft and opens the rewrite panel.
Shortcuts.BackendHint: How this computer delivers the shortcut to Juvin.
Shortcuts.ExtensionMirrorHint: Inside the browser, the Juvin extension answers the same keys on its own. To change them there, use the browser's extension shortcut settings.
Shortcuts.Recorder.NeedsKey: Keep the modifiers held and press a key.
Shortcuts.Recorder.NeedsModifier: Add Ctrl, Alt, Shift, or Super to the key.
Shortcuts.Recorder.NeedsModifierMac: Add Cmd, Option, Shift, or Ctrl to the key.
Shortcuts.Recorder.UnsupportedKey: That key cannot be part of a shortcut.
Shortcuts.SaveFailed: The shortcut could not be saved: {0}
Shortcuts.Status.NoBackend: No shortcut service can run in this session. The browser extension shortcut still works inside the browser.
Shortcuts.Status.InvalidShortcut: The saved shortcut is not valid. Record a new one.
Shortcuts.DesktopShortcut.SignInNote: Takes effect after you sign in again.
Shortcuts.DesktopShortcut.RemovedUntilSi: The desktop shortcut was removed. The desktop keeps the old binding until you sign in again.
Shortcuts.DesktopShortcut.RemoveFailed: The desktop shortcut could not be removed: {0}
Shortcuts.TestHint: Press the shortcut now to check that Juvin hears it.
Wizard.Shortcut.Title: Check your shortcut
Wizard.Shortcut.Body: This shortcut captures the draft you are writing and opens the rewrite panel. Press it once to make sure Juvin hears it.
RewriteActions.Title: Rewrite actions
RewriteActions.Subtitle: What Juvin can do to a draft.
RewriteActions.DefaultHint: Runs as soon as a capture arrives. Pick a different action in the panel at any time.
RewriteActions.BuiltInHint: Edit what each action asks the model to do. Reset brings back the original.
RewriteActions.MissingHint: Returns advice, not a rewrite, so Apply is disabled for it.
RewriteActions.InstructionInvalid: Enter an instruction of up to 2,000 characters. It is saved once it fits.
RewriteActions.CustomHint: Your own instructions. They appear as chips in the panel and can be the default.
RewriteActions.TitlePlaceholder: Name, for example Make it formal
RewriteActions.InstructionPlaceholder: What the model should do with the draft
RewriteActions.TitleInvalid: Enter a name of up to 40 characters. The action is saved once it has a name and an instruction.
RewriteActions.SaveFailed: The changes could not be saved: {0}. They are kept here until Retry succeeds.
BrowserConnector.Title: Browser connector
BrowserConnector.Subtitle: Connects Juvin to the browser extension that reads and replaces your draft.
BrowserConnector.DetectedHint: Browsers on this computer and whether Juvin is registered with each.
BrowserConnector.ExtensionHint: The Juvin extension is not in the browser stores yet. The instructions show how to load it in Firefox or Chrome.
BrowserConnector.TestHint: Checks that the extension can reach Juvin.
BrowserConnector.NoBrowsers: No supported browser was found on this computer. Install Firefox or a Chromium-based browser, then check again.
BrowserConnector.HostMissingHint: juvin-host is not next to Juvin, so browsers cannot be registered. Reinstall Juvin, or for development set {0} to a juvin-host build.
BrowserConnector.State.Stale: Needs update: registered to another copy of Juvin
BrowserConnector.SandboxSocketFailed: Registered, but Juvin could not open the socket this browser connects through ({0}). Check again retries.
BrowserConnector.NoneConnected: No extension is connected. Open a browser that has the extension installed.
Models.Title: Models
Models.Subtitle: Where your drafts are rewritten, and which model does it.
Models.ModeHint: Where your drafts and threads are sent to be rewritten.
Models.LocalModelHint: The model that rewrites your drafts. Refresh lists the models on the server.
PrivacyAndData.Title: Privacy and data
PrivacyAndData.Subtitle: What Juvin keeps on this computer. Nothing is kept unless you turn it on.
PrivacyAndData.HistoryHint: Keep past rewrites on this computer, removed after the retention period.
PrivacyAndData.ProvenanceHint: Record which model and prompt produced each rewrite.
PrivacyAndData.CrashHint: Off by default. Reports never include email content.
PrivacyAndData.DeleteAllHint: Remove history, settings, and stored keys.
General.Title: General
General.Subtitle: How Juvin starts and behaves on this computer.
General.LaunchAtLoginHint: Start Juvin in the background when you sign in.
General.CloseToTrayHint: Closing the window keeps Juvin running in the system tray.
General.NoTrayHint: No system tray was found, so closing the window exits Juvin.
About.Title: About
About.LicenseHint: Juvin is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3.
About.DiagnosticsHint: Export logs for a bug report. Logs never contain email content.
Wizard.Checklist.Empty: Nothing extra to set up on this computer.
Wizard.SaveFailed: Your settings could not be saved: {0}
Provider.Status.Unreachable: The model server could not be reached.
Provider.Status.BadResponse: The server answered, but not like an OpenAI-compatible model server.
Provider.Status.RemoteModel: The chosen model runs in Ollama's cloud, not on the server. Choose a model that runs on the server.
Provider.Status.NotAChatModel: The chosen model only makes embeddings and cannot write text. Choose a chat model.
Provider.Status.NotInstalled: The Codex CLI is not installed.
Provider.Status.CodexNeedsUpdate: The Codex CLI is too old for Juvin. Update it and check again.
Provider.Status.NotSignedIn: The Codex CLI is not signed in. Run codex login.
Provider.Status.CodexNotResponding: The Codex CLI did not respond.
Models.Mode.LocalHint: Drafts stay on this computer or on a server on your own network.
Models.Mode.CodexHint: Uses the Codex CLI you are signed in to. Juvin stores no API key.
Models.CodexConsent: In Codex mode, your draft and the email thread are sent to OpenAI under your ChatGPT subscription.
Models.LocalServerHint: An OpenAI-compatible server such as Ollama, LM Studio, or llama.cpp. Press Enter to save.
Models.ThinkingHint: Rewrites are faster and stay closer to your draft with thinking off.
Models.CodexPathHint: Leave empty to find codex on your PATH.
Models.CodexModelHint: Leave empty to use the Codex default model.
Models.CodexStatusHint: Checks that the Codex CLI is installed and signed in.
Models.Status.InvalidUrl: Enter an http or https address, for example http://localhost:11434.
Models.Status.CheckFailed: The check failed unexpectedly. Try again.
Wizard.Mode.Title: Choose where rewrites run
Wizard.Mode.Body: Local keeps your email on this computer or your own network. Codex uses your ChatGPT subscription through the Codex CLI. You can change this later in Models.
Wizard.Mode.OnlyLowQuality: Only fast, lower quality models are installed. A 20B-class model rewrites much more faithfully.
Wizard.Mode.NoModels: The server has no models yet. A 20B-class model is recommended.
Wizard.Mode.NothingFound: Local mode needs a model server. Install Ollama or LM Studio, start it, then check again.
Wizard.Connector.Title: Connect your browser
Wizard.Connector.Body: Registering a browser lets the Juvin extension in it talk to this app. Register the browsers you use, then install the extension. You can do this later in Browser connector.
Panel.Title: Juvin rewrite
Panel.Subject: SUBJECT
Panel.NoMessages: No thread messages were captured, only the draft.
Panel.OlderMessagesLeftOutOne: 1 older message was left out to fit the model's limit.
Panel.OlderMessagesLeftOut: {0} older messages were left out to fit the model's limit.
Panel.FollowUpPlaceholder: Ask for a change, then press Enter
Panel.DraftChanged: Draft changed. The draft was edited after it was captured, so Apply would overwrite your edits. Copy the rewrite, or Recapture to start again from the current draft.
Panel.Error.NoActiveTab: The tab where you pressed the shortcut is gone. Go back to your draft and press the shortcut again.
Panel.Error.NoAdapter: Juvin found no draft editor on this page.
Panel.Error.NoEditor: Juvin found no draft editor. Click into your draft and try again.
Panel.Error.NoSelection: Nothing is selected. Select the text of your draft, then try again.
Panel.Error.PageNotReady: The page is not ready for Juvin. Reload it and try again.
Panel.Error.NoBrowser: No browser is connected to Juvin. Open your browser with the Juvin extension, then press the shortcut again.
Panel.Error.BrowserNotFocused: Focus the browser with your draft and press the shortcut again.
Panel.Error.EditorGone: The draft editor is no longer on the page. Copy the rewrite instead.
Panel.Error.Disconnected: The browser disconnected. Copy the rewrite, or press the shortcut again in the browser.
Panel.Error.Timeout: The browser did not answer in time. Try again.
Panel.Error.TooLarge: The rewrite is too large to send to the browser. Copy it instead.
Panel.Error.Unknown: The browser could not complete the request.
